g.data-name: DNA contains four nitrogenous bases that form the rungs of the double helix ladder: Adenine A - A purine base Thymine T - A pyrimidine base Guanine G - A purine base Cytosine C - A pyrimidine base These bases attach to a sugar-phosphate backbone

text.tspan: that form the "rungs" of the double helix ladder:
the characteristic twisted ladder shape of DNA.
that are essential for DNA replication and stability.
